<function name="SetForward" parent="VMatrix" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the forward direction of the matrix.

ie. The first column of the matrix, excluding the w coordinate.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="forward" type="Vector">The forward direction of the matrix.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
